A '''blue-bladed lightsaber''' was [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|wielded]] by the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She used it to battle [[Galen Marek]] during the [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|Mission to Felucia]], as well as to defend [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].

Her skill in lightsaber combat even permitted her to hold off [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] for a while during the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Battle of Hypori]] and [[Galen Marek]] during her duel with him, although only for a while.

==Specifications==
Shaak Ti was regarded as one of the most powerful Jedi of her time, both in her mastery of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as in her [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] skills, which she mastered to a degree that made her one of the finest swordswomen in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] regarded Shaak Ti as the most cunning Jedi he'd met, saying that she'd taught him a few tricks. Shaak Ti was a master of the [[Form II/Legends|Makashi]] and [[Form IV/Legends|Ataru]] forms,<ref name="The Force Unleashed Novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref> which determined her grace, serenity, fluency, and elegance in lightsaber combat. Even though these styles were considered to be better against lightsaber wielding opponents than blaster wielding ones, Master Ti was so skilled with the styles that she survived the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Shaak Ti also appeared to have some training in the [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] style, as she expertly wielded an [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]] along with her lightsaber during the Battle of Coruscant, and sources describe her wielding dual lightsabers during the Jedi Purge<ref name="The Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>. Shaak Ti was grouped among the six "great swordbeings" of the Jedi Order.<ref name="ROTS novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Shaak Ti's lightsaber was wrongly colored green in the Clone Wars: 1, Defense of Kamino.

Shaak Ti lost the saber to Grievous during the Battle of Coruscant, and it can later be seen in the General's cape in Episode III. As Anakin and Obi-Wan retrieved their own sabers but left hers, it is unknown how Ti recovered the saber or if she even recovered it, as she could have constructed a new one to look like the first.

In the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]], [[Wikipedia:Wii|ii]] and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]] versions of [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''The Force Unleashed'']], Shaak Ti's lightsaber hilt can be selected for use if the player can find it in the first Felucia level.

Also in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] version of the game, Shaak Ti dies with her saber in her hand; however, in the PS2, Wii and PSP versions, Starkiller recovers it for his master.
